contract.direct_answer:
Assembly workflow (Morpheus CPM/multiscale) for early embryonic zebrafish cornea, mapping each step to the retrieved evidence niches:

STEP 1 — Geometry & cell population initialization. Define the 2D/3D Lattice, initial cell fields and regional domains (cornea/anterior-segment territory). Source: CORPUS-2026-0002 (temporal scRNA atlas of anterior segment development, closes the "cornea gap") gives cell types and staging to seed populations; RN13 provides the Morpheus .xml scaffolding. Framework: staged-atlas-to-CellType mapping. Confidence in having the right cell identities: moderate. GAP: the atlas is trabecular-meshwork/annular-ligament centric — it may not resolve true corneal epithelial/stromal/endothelial layers at the earliest embryonic stages.

STEP 2 — Cell adhesion / passive biomechanics (CellType + Interaction/contact energy). Populate affinity matrices, basal cortical tension and cell-friction coefficients from RN6 (Biomecánica pasiva y ECM; affinity matrices + regional stiffness as .json). These map directly onto Morpheus Contact energies, SurfaceConstraint/tension, and friction terms. Framework: CPM Hamiltonian parameterization (adhesion-driven sorting). Confidence: moderate–good, because RN6 explicitly provides Morpheus-ready .json. GAP: RN6 parameters are generic passive-mechanics/ECM — need to confirm they were measured for cornea and at embryonic (not adult) stages.

STEP 3 — Cell dynamics / collective kinetics (Motility + Events/Apoptosis). Use RN8 (Cinética celular colectiva) per-region/per-stage statistics: mean migration velocity, apoptosis %/hr, and raw trajectories. Encode as Morpheus persistent-motion / directed-motion plugins, and death Events. Framework: data-driven motility & turnover calibration. Confidence: moderate. GAP: RN8 is per-region — need cornea-specific rows; trajectory noise/anisotropy for the neural-crest-derived corneal migration is not confirmed present.

STEP 4 — Diffusive fields (PDE Fields + Reaction/secretion). Add morphogen/signalling fields as Morpheus PDE Fields with production/decay tied to CellTypes. NO evidence bundle item provides diffusion coefficients, secretion rates, or ligand identities for cornea. Framework: reaction–diffusion coupling to CPM — but here it is unsourced. Confidence: LOW. GAP (major): diffusive-field parameters are entirely missing from this bundle.

STEP 5 — Integration, output, validation. Wire CellTypes + Interactions + Motility + Fields + Time in the RN13 Morpheus .xml; validate simulated morphology/dynamics against RN8 velocities/apoptosis and the CORPUS-2026-0002 staging. Framework: simulate-compare-recalibrate loop. Confidence: moderate for the mechanical/kinetic parts, LOW overall because the diffusive layer and true corneal (vs meshwork/pronephros) grounding are weak.

Overall framework: multiscale CPM (Cellular Potts, Morpheus) assembled niche-by-niche — RN6 (adhesion/mechanics) + RN8 (dynamics) + RN13 (code) + CORPUS-2026-0002 (cell identity/geometry). The two structural building blocks (adhesion, dynamics) are well supported; geometry is partially supported; diffusive fields are NOT supported by this bundle.</parameter>
<parameter name="confidence">0.34
alternatives_considered: Vertex/tissue-mechanics model instead of CPM — but RN6/RN8/RN13 are explicitly Morpheus-formatted, so CPM in Morpheus is the intended path.

Using CORPUS-2026-0003 (pronephros tubulogenesis, Prkci/Prkcz polarity) as an epithelial-morphogenesis template — rejected as primary source because it is a different organ (kidney) though it could inform epithelial polarity plugins.
Treating the anterior-segment atlas as fully corneal — rejected/flagged because it is trabecular-meshwork/annular-ligament focused, not confirmed corneal-layer resolved.
gap_flags: No diffusive-field parameters in bundle (diffusion coefficients, secretion/decay rates, ligand identities) — Step 4 is unsourced/LOW confidence.
CORPUS-2026-0002 is trabecular-meshwork/annular-ligament centric; true early corneal epithelial/stromal/endothelial identities may be missing.
RN6 mechanics (.json) not confirmed cornea-specific or embryonic-stage-specific vs adult/generic.
RN8 kinetics are per-region/per-stage but cornea-specific rows not verified present.
No gene identifiers resolved/verified in DI (Key entities: none checked); no ENSDARG grounding available.
